coherent_extrema_witness.source_semantics: The source takes finite maxima or unions over complete insertion/removal families and, where two extrema appear, compares their values without claiming they share a maximizing pool.
coherent_extrema_witness.lean_semantics: Lean uses the same complete finite unions, maxima, exact-value predicates, or universal bounds and does not manufacture one joint witness from unrelated coordinatewise extrema.
coherent_extrema_witness.relation_basis: The source and Lean agree on whether a claim concerns a bound, an exact realized value, or equality of two separately computed maxima; every required witness is coherent within its own extremum.
coherent_extrema_witness.source_extrema_semantics: Variability is a maximum of a pool-level displacement-union cardinality, and general variability is the maximum of the separately defined insertion and removal maxima.
coherent_extrema_witness.lean_extrema_semantics: The expanded predicates use the same finite family and nesting of maxima, with exact-value rows proving both the upper bound and a single pool that realizes the asserted value.
coherent_extrema_witness.coherent_witness_basis: Exact variability conclusions include one realizing pool for the relevant maximum; equalities between two maxima compare their values and do not require one pool to realize both.
coherent_extrema_witness.runner_refinement_basis: No external optimizer or independently supplied output is used; the theorem reasons directly about the same finite union/max predicates that define the source extremum.
coherent_extrema_witness.lean_evidence_statement: The complete Lean conclusion exposes the corresponding exact-value, range, equality, or upper-bound fact for the recursively expanded source extremum.

cardinality_fibers.source_semantics: The source upper-bounds LAP variability by the number of distinct strict total orders induced by the finite slot family, identifying slots only when their comparisons agree on all applicants.
cardinality_fibers.lean_semantics: Lean defines equality of slot orders extensionally, forms the canonical quotient image of slots by that order, and proves variability at most the cardinality of the resulting distinct-order set.
cardinality_fibers.relation_basis: Both sides count distinct realized slot-induced orders and assert only an upper bound on variability; neither equates a syntactic slot count with nonempty behavioral fibers.
cardinality_fibers.source_counted_object: The counted object is the finite set of distinct total applicant orders actually induced by the LAP slots.
cardinality_fibers.lean_counted_object: The counted object is the canonical Finset image of slots under their extensional strict-order relation, with duplicate slot orders collapsed.
cardinality_fibers.realized_fiber_semantics: The theorem needs no nonempty-fiber equality: each slot maps definitionally to one induced order, and the claim is an upper bound indexed by the image cardinality.
cardinality_fibers.surjectivity_basis: Surjectivity onto the canonical image is definitional, but no surjectivity from order classes to distinct choice outcomes is asserted or needed for the upper bound.
cardinality_fibers.lean_evidence_statement: The Lean conclusion proves the same variability upper bound using the extensional distinct slot-order count.
